remarks_1999: Double entries Whitney Archive. Whitney Archive indicates owner in 1946 wrote in response to WQ, "Signature of Georgia O'Keeffe –– O'Keeffe seldom signs her pictures I am told but I asked her to sign this one & I think the signature is in the lower corner. Miss O'Keeffe writes me she put a 'star' on the picture. In reading Georgia O'Keeffe's letter, I see that she says 'I have put my star and my name on the back of your picture.'" Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Back: Signed. Note: Bought January 1939." Reproduced and titled *Calla Lilies* in *Independent Woman* (November 1940) and oriented as a horizontal with anemone on left. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks, 1929 New York (Intimate Gallery) exhibition checklist.
titles.title: Calla Lilies with Red Anemone

description: Two white calla lilies with bright yellow stamens spring from the center of the work. Behind the lower calla lily is a red anemone flower with a purplish-black center. All of the flowers rest against a textured white background that resembles draped fabric.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
